probe_scope: unauthenticated network/path probes only; no generation request

contract_assessment.previous_503_root_cause: unknown; likely post-auth route/upstream/capacity/transient but not proven

retry_policy.provider_unavailable_mapping: provider_unavailable, retryable=true, external outcome must be preserved
retry_policy.minimum_next_probe: one authenticated, low-cost, fixed-input text.format json_schema probe after backend confirms model and budget
full_generation_allowed_when: output_text parses and local schema validates
backend backup and deployment receipt exist

handoff.backend: confirm authenticated model list, actual model ID, budget and request timeline; do not sync local secret file
handoff.qa: run one minimal authenticated structured-output probe; do not repeat full chapter before it passes
handoff.ai_generation: review response contract and error mapping after probe; no deployment or key handling
